negative_findings.description: No single consolidated public calendar of Hungarian banking/payments regulatory events was found; MNB itself has no unified 'események' calendar covering supervision, payments and green finance together — event announcements are scattered across felügyeleti hírek, penzforgalom/konzultacio, penzugyi-stabilitas/konferenciak-eloadasok and greenfinance/esemenyek.
negative_findings.result_summary: Four separate MNB sub-sites must be polled instead of one calendar.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must treat MNB event discovery as a multi-endpoint crawl, otherwise consultations will be missed.

negative_findings.description: Searches for downloadable slide decks from MNB payments-themed professional days and from GIRO Zrt. professional days did not surface a public, systematic deck repository; decks appear only ad hoc, attached to individual news items.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slide-deck harvesting will be opportunistic rather than systematic for payments events.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Speaker slides are the highest-value artefact in this cell; their absence means agendas and speaker lists must carry the analytical load.

negative_findings.description: Several event URLs (ffs.ap.hu, digitalpayment.hu, iir-hungary.hu legacy query URLs, hunfintech.com) were seen only in search results and were not fetched in this pass; some are edition-specific and may rotate per year.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs recorded with moderate confidence; liveness left to the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Edition-scoped conference URLs commonly move (e.g. /2025/ → /2026/), so the collector needs a fallback to the organiser root domain.

negative_findings.description: Conference attendance and most training programmes (Portfolio, IIR, Bankárképző, Big-4 webinars) are paid or registration-gated; only agendas and speaker lists are consistently public.
negative_findings.result_summary: Public layer = agenda + speakers; content layer = gated.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets a hard ceiling on what can be lawfully collected in this cell and argues for agenda/speaker-metadata collection rather than content capture.

coverage_gaps.description: Sectoral regulators/bodies beyond MNB that host regulatory events were not covered in this pass: Ministry for National Economy (NGM) consultations, Hungarian Competition Authority (GVH) financial-sector workshops, NAIH (data protection) financial webinars, and the Budapest Stock Exchange (BÉT) academy.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up scout on ngm.gov.hu, gvh.hu, naih.hu and bet.hu event/consultation pages with Hungarian event terms.

coverage_gaps.description: Speaker rosters and slide decks increasingly live on LinkedIn and YouTube (event recordings, post-event recaps by MNB staff and law firms) rather than on organiser websites; this channel was not explored.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a targeted pass over LinkedIn event pages/company posts and YouTube channels of MNB, Portfolio, FinTechZone and Bankárképző; note LinkedIn scraping restrictions and prefer manual/API-compliant access.

coverage_gaps.description: Law-firm client seminars and webinars (e.g. Hungarian banking/fintech practices) — a classic early-warning channel for imminent obligations — were not systematically enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout Hungarian financial-regulatory law firm event/insight pages with terms 'szeminárium', 'ügyfél tájékoztató', 'reggeli', 'webinárium'.

coverage_gaps.description: Archive depth was not assessed: it is unclear how far back each organiser keeps past agendas and speaker lists, which limits trend analysis on how topics migrate year to year.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each priority organiser, probe past-edition URL patterns and register Wayback Machine snapshots as a fallback archive.

coverage_gaps.description: Some organisers publish an English mirror (Portfolio /en/events) but most Hungarian training catalogues are Hungarian-only; English-only monitoring would miss the majority of the cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Make Hungarian-language crawling mandatory for this cell; use English mirrors only for cross-checking speaker affiliations.

brief: The Hungarian banking/payments event landscape splits into three tiers: (1) the regulator itself — MNB runs supervisory 'szakmai konzultációk', payments consultations, financial-stability presentation archives and thematic green-finance events across four separate sub-sites with no unified calendar; (2) commercial conference organisers — Portfolio.hu is dominant (Financial IT, Future of Finance), alongside payments-specific shows (Digital Payment, PayTechShow/TechShow X, Financial Fraud Summit) whose programmes name MNB directorate staff as speakers and preview AFR/ISO 20022, PSD3/PSR, DORA and MNB's AI expectations; and (3) the training layer — Nemzetközi Bankárképző Központ, Budapest Institute of Banking, IIR Hungary and Big-4 webinars, whose course catalogues cite specific MNB decrees and recommendations and therefore act as a demand-side index of which obligations banks are actually staffing for. Agendas and speaker lists are reliably public while the content itself is paywalled or registration-gated, so the practical collection target is agenda + speaker + affiliation metadata plus opportunistically published slide PDFs. Hungarian-language monitoring is mandatory: English mirrors exist only for Portfolio and aggregators, and the training catalogues that carry the sharpest deadline signals are Hungarian-only.
